items.heading: A Single "Product Manager Salary
items.text: A single "product manager salary in India" figure hides more than it reveals, because company tier and demonstrated outcomes drive pay far more than tenure alone in this field.

rows: Concentrated almost entirely at larger product companies and well-funded startups running dedicated APM programmes; genuinely rare at smaller companies, which rarely hire PMs straight out of college.
The widest band in the field, driven heavily by company tier, prior domain expertise, and demonstrated product outcomes rather than years alone.
Requires genuine ownership of a product area's strategy and metrics, not just feature delivery, the jump to senior is a scope jump, not a tenure milestone.
Concentrated at large product companies, unicorn startups, and global capability centres of multinational tech firms, requires managing other PMs and cross-functional organisational influence.

items.heading: A Product Manager Decides What
items.text: A product manager decides what a product should do and why, working across engineering, design, sales, and customer data to prioritise what actually gets built, not build it themselves.

items.heading: The Daily Work Is Mostly
items.text: The daily work is mostly coordination, prioritisation, and communication, writing specs, running stakeholder discussions, analysing usage data, and constantly saying no to more ideas than get built, not the glamorous "visionary" image often sold in course marketing.
